title: Rapid screening of novel tyrosinase inhibitory peptides from a pearl shell meat hydrolysate by molecular docking and the anti-melanin mechanism.
authors: Huang, Pantian; Miao, Jianyin; Liao, Wanwen; Huang, Congshu; Chen, Bingbing; Li, Yingkun; Wang, Xianghua; Yu, Yan; Liang, Xingtang; Zhao, Haishan; Cao, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接筛选珍珠蚌肉水解物中的酪氨酸酶抑制肽并研究其美白机制，对象为小肽-酪氨酸酶互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pearls are an edible and medicinal resource with whitening activity and nutritional value in China. In the previous study, we found that the pearl shell meat hydrolysate showed dual activities of antioxidation and tyrosinase inhibition, which were similar to the activities of pearls. In this research, a pearl shell meat hydrolysate was isolated, identified and screened by molecular docking, and three peptides FLF, SPSSS and WLL with high tyrosinase inhibitory activities were obtained. The results indicated that FLF, SPSSS and WLL could effectively inhibit tyrosinase activities and the inhibition rates (1.0 mg mL(-1)) were 54.32%, 65.26% and 57.50%, respectively. The results of a zebrafish whitening experiment showed that the tyrosinase activities of zebrafish treated with FLF, SPSSS and WLL decreased by 75.41%, 62.87% and 64.99% (p < 0.05), respectively, and the melanin content decreased by 37.34%, 38.52% and 40.39% (p < 0.05), respectively. In a B16F10 cell whitening experiment, compared with a control group, FLF, SPSSS and WLL also showed a significant whitening effect, the tyrosinase activities decreased by 84.08%, 79.08% and 77.45% (p < 0.05), respectively, and the melanin content decreased by 42.23%, 34.37% and 34.02% (p < 0.05), respectively. Moreover, the active peptides could act on three signal pathways including Wnt/beta-catenin, MAPK and MC1R/alpha-MSH and significantly downregulated the expressions of the signaling factors WNT4, MITF, beta-catenin, ERK, JNK, TRP1 and TRP2 (p < 0.05). The results demonstrated that the whitening active peptides were edible natural antioxidants, tyrosinase inhibitors and skin anti-melanin agents, which could be added to functional foods as food ingredients.
abstract_zh: 珍珠是我国一种具有美白活性和营养价值的食用药用资源。前期研究发现，珍珠壳肉水解物具有抗氧化和酪氨酸酶抑制双重活性，与珍珠的活性相似。本研究通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 对珍珠壳肉水解物进行分离、鉴定和筛选，获得三个具有高酪氨酸酶抑制活性的多肽 FLF、SPSSS 和 WLL。结果表明，FLF、SPSSS 和 WLL 能有效抑制酪氨酸酶活性，其抑制率（1.0 mg mL(-1)）分别为 54.32%、65.26% 和 57.50%。斑马鱼美白实验结果显示，经 FLF、SPSSS 和 WLL 处理的斑马鱼酪氨酸酶活性分别降低 75.41%、62.87% 和 64.99%（p < 0.05），黑色素含量分别降低 37.34%、38.52% 和 40.39%（p < 0.05）。在 B16F10 细胞美白实验中，与对照组相比，FLF、SPSSS 和 WLL 也表现出显著的美白效果，酪氨酸酶活性分别降低 84.08%、79.08% 和 77.45%（p < 0.05），黑色素含量分别降低 42.23%、34.37% 和 34.02%（p < 0.05）。此外，活性多肽可作用于 Wnt/beta-catenin、MAPK 和 MC1R/alpha-MSH 三条信号通路，并显著下调信号因子 WNT4、MITF、beta-catenin、ERK、JNK、TRP1 和 TRP2 的表达（p < 0.05）。结果表明，美白活性多肽是可食用的天然抗氧化剂、酪氨酸酶抑制剂和皮肤抗黑色素剂，可作为食品配料添加到功能性食品中。
